decisions.statement: One kind is put up by this service, and the code beside this page names that kind.
An ios deploy builds the app and hands the build to Apple, which nothing undoes.
A tick may hand a build to Apple without anyone asking, as Alan settled.
Each ios app states the hour it waits before a tick hands Apple another build.
An ios build wants secrets from Alan's file, so this service reads that file.
A tick with every ios app up to date puts nothing up, so that is no loop without end.

definition: the service putting the ios app kind up once a commit changes what it is built from
